business_summary: Autocrypt Co., Ltd. provides cybersecurity software solutions for vehicles and smart roads in South Korea, Asia, Europe, and North America. The company offers in-vehicle systems security solutions, including AutoCrypt IDS, a vehicular intrusion detection solution that detects, filters, and prevents cyberattacks against in-vehicle systems; AutoCrypt HSM, a software module that integrated with the hardware security module; AutoCrypt Security Analyzer, a software analysis platform that generates the software bill of materials through function-level analysis; AutoCrypt Security Fuzzer, a smart fuzzing tool that detects software coding flaws by repeatedly feeding AI-generated random inputs; AutoCrypt ASL, an adaptive security library designed for the AUTOSAR adaptive platform; and AutoCrypt TEE, an ASPICE CL2-certified in-vehicle systems security solution that utilizes a trusted execution environment to protect SoC platforms. It also provides secure vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communications, such as AutoCrypt V2X-EE, a security module that supports encryption and decryption work via a local certificate manager; AutoCrypt V2X-PKI, a security credential management system-based authentication architecture; an AutoCrypt IMS, an integrated certificate management tool for the security credential management system; Autocrypt pnc (plug and charge), a secure communication module and PKI-based certificate management system; and EVIQ, an all-on-one EV information and charging platform that provides a charging station management system for CPOS, as well as charger information and mapping apps for consumers. In addition, the company offers AutoCrypt RODAS, a remote driving solution for autonomous vehicles; AutoCrypt KEY, a cryptographic key management solution; and AutoCrypt MOVE, a secure mobility platform for mobility service operators. Further, it provides security and tool testing, and consulting services. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
